CustomField.label: Height (px)
CustomField.description: The child grid's height in pixels, in the panel under an open row; the panel grows to fit it. If blank, 388 pixels under a row of a top-level grid and 168 one level down. Values below 160 are treated as 160. A child grid with fewer rows takes less room; one with more scrolls inside.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Optional. How tall the child grid is under an open row, in pixels. Leave blank for the standard height.
